 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Colby Parkinson has been battling through multiple injuries this season and he was banged up a few times during Sunday's game against the Las Vegas Raiders . After leaving briefly earlier in the game, Parkinson exited in the third quarter after being shaken up on a play. He went down to a knee and was hobbled off the field before being taken into the medical tent.
 Parkinson has dealt with knee and shoulder injuries for most of the year, so this is just the latest instance of him battling some sort of ailment.
 Parkinson had four catches for 33 yards at the time that he left the game.
